metadata.title: MergeCsv
metadata.description: Use Svendsen Tech's Merge-Csv function to merge CSV files and/or custom PowerShell objects based one or more shared ID properties. Online documentation here: http://www.powershelladmin.com/wiki/Merge_CSV_files_or_PSObjects_in_PowerShell

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

findings.title: Encoded or compressed content used with dynamic execution
findings.description: Encoded or compressed data is used alongside dynamic evaluation. This can appear in legitimate tooling; review the surrounding logic.

evidence.snippet: PS C:\> Merge-Csv -Path users.csv, user-mail.csv -Id Username | Export-Csv -enc UTF8 merged.csv
